copy.en:
Three Adjustable Handle Heights
Aluminum frame and hinged opening provide quicker access than zipper cases.
Foldable phone holder on handle
Polyester lining inside suitcase
copy.zh:
三档拉杆高度可调
铝合金框架配铰链开合，比拉链箱开启更快捷
拉杆配备可折叠手机支架
箱内采用涤纶内衬
copy.de:
Drei einstellbare Griffhöhen
Aluminiumrahmen und Scharnieröffnung ermöglichen schnelleren Zugriff als Reißverschlusskoffer.
Klappbare Handyhalterung am Griff
Polyesterfutter im Koffer
copy.fr:
Trois hauteurs de poignée réglables
Le cadre aluminium et l’ouverture articulée facilitent l’accès par rapport aux fermetures éclair.
Support téléphone pliable sur la poignée
Doublure intérieure en polyester
copy.it:
Tre altezze del manico regolabili
Telaio in alluminio e apertura a cerniera facilitano l’accesso rispetto alle zip.
Supporto pieghevole per smartphone sul manico
Fodera interna in poliestere
copy.es:
Tres alturas de asa ajustables
El marco de aluminio y la apertura con bisagra facilitan el acceso frente a cremalleras.
Soporte plegable para móvil en el asa
Forro interior de poliéster

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为拉杆三档高度调节，采用结构分解与真实局部放大呈现，不重复泛化铝合金拉杆。PC画布2000×2000：产品主体位于左侧约[x,y,w,h]=[0.12,0.28,0.76,0.39]，使用单一枪灰色13A旅行箱，三分之四视角、轻微打开；依次分层展示硬壳、铝合金框架、铰链连接、三档拉杆位置、可折叠手机支架和涤纶内衬。三档用三个半透明高度轮廓表示，不能画成三组实体拉杆。右侧及上下文案按元素顺序对应：slot 0标题置顶居中，突出“三档/Three/Drei/Trois/Tre/Tres”；slot 1为支持说明，解释铝合金框架与铰链开合相较拉链箱更快捷；slot 2连接拉杆手机支架局部放大；slot 3连接箱内涤纶内衬局部放大。移动端1200×1200：上方产品与分解结构约占[x,y,w,h]=[0.18,0.29,0.64,0.39]，底部四行文案自上而下排列，slot 2和slot 3左右分栏并保留德语扩展空间。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和暖灰背景、自然侧光和柔和接触阴影；金属框保持真实克制的反光，使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体。不得表现材料厚度数值、截面尺寸、测试效果或夸张强度；仅通过真实组件分层、边缘反光和连接关系展示结构。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的三档拉杆、可折叠手机支架、铝合金框架、铰链开合和涤纶内衬信息。不得将产品描述为全铝箱，不得虚构框架厚度、承重、耐冲击等级、测试结果、认证或安全保证。可进行中性结构对比，表达相较拉链箱开启更快捷，但不得加入具体时间、绝对化领先、竞品品牌或贬损性表述。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ exploded-structure product visual for a modern travel suitcase, square composition with PC and mobile-responsive layout. Show one gunmetal-gray hard-shell suitcase in a three-quarter view, slightly open, with realistic layered separation of the shell, aluminum frame, hinged opening connection, telescopic handle, foldable phone holder, and polyester lining. Show three translucent handle-height position outlines to communicate three adjustable heights, never three physical handles. Include two restrained macro-detail insets: one for the foldable phone holder on the handle and one for the polyester interior lining. Add a faint generic zipper suitcase silhouette only as a neutral structural comparison, with no logos, no timing, no competition, and no damage. Warm low-saturation gray background, natural side lighting, soft contact shadows, controlled metallic reflections, premium European travel photography, clean technical composition, ample reserved negative space for headline, supporting line, and two callouts. Use realistic proportions and visible component connections. NO rendered text, NO labels, NO logos, NO brand marks, NO icons, NO specifications, NO numbers.
